products.name: 2short.ai
products.note: YouTube shorts AI; clip extraction; content automation; platform dependency

profile_text.body:
2short.ai is a web-based tool designed to help YouTube creators repurpose long-form video content into short clips. The service describes itself as an AI-powered YouTube Shorts generator that extracts what it calls the most engaging moments from a video by analyzing spoken words and captions. Users paste a YouTube link into the application and the tool processes the video automatically. The site notes that the product works best with caption-enabled videos containing spoken content, including podcasts, educational videos, product reviews, and motivational speeches, and that YouTube's auto-generated captions make most videos compatible.

The platform includes a facial tracking feature that the company describes as keeping active speakers centered on screen during clip generation. Supported languages span more than two dozen, including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and others. Pricing plans are differentiated primarily by AI video analysis hours, and the company offers a free Starter plan that includes 15 minutes of AI video analysis.

The site's held facts list one product, 2short.ai, categorized under Video Generation and Editing, with notes flagging clip extraction, content automation, and platform dependency. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the company.
